_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: outbox_fifo
data.sql: CREATE INDEX outbox_fifo ON outbox (space_id, created_at, id);

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "spaces" ("id" TEXT, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced' CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), "base_version" INTEGER, "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "name" TEXT, "accent_color" TEXT, "currency" TEXT, "timezone" TEXT, "is_default" INTEGER, "version" INTEGER, "change_seq" INTEGER, "role" TEXT, "member_id" TEXT, "join_epoch" INTEGER, "modules" TEXT, "local_generation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(space_id, id), CHECK(space_id = id));
CREATE INDEX spaces_space ON spaces (space_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "space_members" ("id" TEXT, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced' CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), "base_version" INTEGER, "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "display_name" TEXT, "role" TEXT, "status" TEXT, "join_epoch" INTEGER, "joined_at" TEXT, "left_at" TEXT, "left_reason" TEXT, "version" INTEGER, "change_seq" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(space_id, id));
CREATE INDEX space_members_space ON space_members (space_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "member_grants" ("space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced' CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "member_id" TEXT, "module" TEXT, "level" TEXT, "change_seq" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(space_id, member_id, module));
CREATE INDEX member_grants_space ON member_grants (space_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced' CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), "base_version" INTEGER, "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "module" TEXT, "visibility" TEXT, "kind" TEXT, "name" TEXT, "is_reserve" INTEGER, "opening_balance_minor" INTEGER, "opening_on" TEXT, "sort_key" INTEGER, "created_by_member_id" TEXT, "archived_at" TEXT, "version" INTEGER, "change_seq" INTEGER, "created_at" TEXT, "updated_at" TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(space_id, id));
CREATE INDEX accounts_space ON accounts (space_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "allocation_plans" ("space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced' CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), "base_version" INTEGER, "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "account_id" TEXT, "amount_minor" INTEGER, "day_of_month" INTEGER, "enabled" INTEGER, "next_run_on" TEXT, "last_run_month" TEXT, "version" INTEGER, "change_seq" INTEGER, "updated_at" TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(space_id, account_id));
CREATE INDEX allocation_plans_space ON allocation_plans (space_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced' CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), "base_version" INTEGER, "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "module" TEXT, "preset_key" TEXT, "name" TEXT, "created_by_member_id" TEXT, "deleted_at" TEXT, "version" INTEGER, "change_seq" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(space_id, id));
CREATE INDEX tags_space ON tags (space_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "records" ("id" TEXT, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced' CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), "base_version" INTEGER, "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "module" TEXT, "visibility" TEXT, "kind" TEXT, "amount_minor" INTEGER, "occurred_on" TEXT, "account_id" TEXT, "to_account_id" TEXT, "purpose_id" TEXT, "to_purpose_id" TEXT, "refund_of_id" TEXT, "tag_ids" TEXT, "note" TEXT, "attachments" TEXT, "status" TEXT, "void_reason" TEXT, "origin" TEXT, "run_id" TEXT, "created_by_member_id" TEXT, "updated_by_member_id" TEXT, "version" INTEGER, "change_seq" INTEGER, "created_at" TEXT, "updated_at" TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(space_id, id));
CREATE INDEX records_space ON records (space_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subjects" ("id" TEXT, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced' CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), "base_version" INTEGER, "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "module" TEXT, "visibility" TEXT, "kind" TEXT, "name" TEXT, "member_id" TEXT, "archived_at" TEXT, "deleted_at" TEXT, "created_by_member_id" TEXT, "version" INTEGER, "change_seq" INTEGER, "created_at" TEXT, "updated_at" TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(space_id, id));
CREATE INDEX subjects_space ON subjects (space_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "documents" ("id" TEXT, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced' CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), "base_version" INTEGER, "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "module" TEXT, "visibility" TEXT, "template_id" TEXT, "template_version" INTEGER, "title" TEXT, "event_date" TEXT, "subject_ids" TEXT, "content" TEXT, "status" TEXT, "origin" TEXT, "run_id" TEXT, "created_by_member_id" TEXT, "updated_by_member_id" TEXT, "version" INTEGER, "change_seq" INTEGER, "created_at" TEXT, "updated_at" TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(space_id, id));
CREATE INDEX documents_space ON documents (space_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entity_events" ("id" INTEGER, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced' CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "entity_kind" TEXT, "entity_id" TEXT, "kind" TEXT, "before" TEXT, "after" TEXT, "actor_member_id" TEXT, "via_api_key_id" TEXT, "via_api_key_name" TEXT, "run_id" TEXT, "request_id" TEXT, "at" TEXT, "change_seq" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(space_id, id));
CREATE INDEX entity_events_space ON entity_events (space_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "conversations" ("id" TEXT, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced' CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "member_id" TEXT, "created_at" TEXT, "change_seq" INTEGER, "server_payload_json" TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(space_id, id));
CREATE INDEX conversations_space ON conversations (space_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_entries" ("id" TEXT, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced' CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "member_id" TEXT, "conversation_id" TEXT, "role" TEXT, "reply_to_id" TEXT, "agent_run_id" TEXT, "protocol_version" TEXT, "fallback_text" TEXT, "stream_status" TEXT, "change_seq" INTEGER, "created_at" TEXT, "updated_at" TEXT, "server_payload_json" TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(space_id, id));
CREATE INDEX chat_entries_space ON chat_entries (space_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "join_epoch" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('tool', 'blob', 'chat_send', 'chat_action', 'chat_retry')), "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "depends_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "request_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'sending', 'failed', 'blocked')), "last_error" TEXT, "lease_until" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX outbox_fifo ON outbox (space_id, created_at, id)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("space_id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "cursor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entity_conflicts" ("space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mine_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "server_status" TEXT, "detected_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(space_id, entity_kind, entity_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "blobs_local" ("space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "module" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "uploaded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "uploaded_at" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(space_id, module, sha256));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_runtime" ("id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "authenticated" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "change_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "notices_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "write_allowed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "identity_json" TEXT, "session_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'full', "space_ids_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "round_owner" TEXT, "round_lease_until" INTEGER, "pending_deletions_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]');
